name: print-social-orange-events-platform-post-with-hands-and-phones-circle
title: Rounded orange card and white message box over a circle of hands with phones, with store badges
whatItIs: A portrait ad with a top-down photo of many hands holding phones, overlaid with a rounded orange card carrying a logo, URL and 'People Are Looking for Events Like Yours Right Now' and an inset white box with a paragraph, plus a bottom brown bar with Google Play and App Store badges and social handles.
whatItMeans: Energetic and communal; a ring of hands says everyone is searching.
techniques: Overlay a rounded card on a busy photo.
Nest a white text box inside the orange card.
Add store badges at the base.

vocabulary.definition: A solid card placed over an image.
A white box inside a coloured card.
